"""
MythTV API Client Library

A Python library for interacting with the MythTV Services API.
"""

import requests
import logging
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any, Union
from urllib.parse import urljoin, quote
import json
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum

# Configure logging
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class RecordingStatus(Enum):
    """Recording status enumeration"""
    UNKNOWN = -13
    TUNING = -12
    FAILING = -11
    TUNER_BUSY = -10
    LOW_DISK_SPACE = -9
    CANCELLED = -8
    MISSED = -7
    ABORTED = -6
    RECORDED = -5
    RECORDING = -4
    WILL_RECORD = -3
    DONT_RECORD = -2
    PREVIOUS_RECORDING = -1
    INACTIVE = 0
    
    
@dataclass
class Program:
    """Represents a MythTV program"""
    title: str
    subtitle: str
    channel_id: int
    start_time: datetime
    end_time: datetime
    description: Optional[str] = None
    category: Optional[str] = None
    series_id: Optional[str] = None
    program_id: Optional[str] = None
    recording_id: Optional[int] = None
    status: Optional[RecordingStatus] = None
    
    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> 'Program':
        """Create Program instance from API response dict"""
        return cls(
            title=data.get('Title', ''),
            subtitle=data.get('SubTitle', ''),
            channel_id=int(data.get('Channel', {}).get('ChanId', 0)),
            start_time=datetime.fromisoformat(data.get('StartTime', '').replace('Z', '+00:00')),
            end_time=datetime.fromisoformat(data.get('EndTime', '').replace('Z', '+00:00')),
            description=data.get('Description'),
            category=data.get('Category'),
            series_id=data.get('SeriesId'),
            program_id=data.get('ProgramId'),
            recording_id=data.get('RecordingId'),
            status=RecordingStatus(int(data.get('Recording', {}).get('Status', 0)))
            if data.get('Recording') else None
        )


@dataclass
class Channel:
    """Represents a MythTV channel"""
    channel_id: int
    channel_number: str
    call_sign: str
    channel_name: str
    visible: bool = True
    
    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> 'Channel':
        """Create Channel instance from API response dict"""
        return cls(
            channel_id=int(data.get('ChanId', 0)),
            channel_number=data.get('ChanNum', ''),
            call_sign=data.get('CallSign', ''),
            channel_name=data.get('ChannelName', ''),
            visible=data.get('Visible', 'true').lower() == 'true'
        )


@dataclass
class Recording:
    """Represents a MythTV recording"""
    recording_id: int
    title: str
    subtitle: str
    start_time: datetime
    end_time: datetime
    channel_name: str
    file_size: int
    file_name: str
    status: RecordingStatus
    
    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> 'Recording':
        """Create Recording instance from API response dict"""
        return cls(
            recording_id=int(data.get('RecordingId', 0)),
            title=data.get('Title', ''),
            subtitle=data.get('SubTitle', ''),
            start_time=datetime.fromisoformat(data.get('StartTime', '').replace('Z', '+00:00')),
            end_time=datetime.fromisoformat(data.get('EndTime', '').replace('Z', '+00:00')),
            channel_name=data.get('Channel', {}).get('ChannelName', ''),
            file_size=int(data.get('FileSize', 0)),
            file_name=data.get('FileName', ''),
            status=RecordingStatus(int(data.get('Recording', {}).get('Status', -5)))
        )


class MythTVAPIError(Exception):
    """Base exception for MythTV API errors"""
    pass


class MythTVClient:
    """
    MythTV Services API Client
    
    Example usage:
        client = MythTVClient('192.168.1.100', port=6544)
        
        # Get all recordings
        recordings = client.get_recordings()
        
        # Get program guide
        guide = client.get_program_guide()
        
        # Search for programs
        results = client.search_programs('Doctor Who')
    """
    
    def __init__(self, host: str, port: int = 6544, username: Optional[str] = None, 
                 password: Optional[str] = None, timeout: int = 30):
        """
        Initialize MythTV API client.
        
        Args:
            host: MythTV backend hostname or IP address
            port: MythTV services API port (default: 6544)
            username: Optional username for authentication
            password: Optional password for authentication
            timeout: Request timeout in seconds
        """
        self.base_url = f"http://{host}:{port}"
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.session = requests.Session()
        
        if username and password:
            self.session.auth = (username, password)
            
        # Set default headers
        self.session.headers.update({
            'Accept': 'application/json',
            'User-Agent': 'MythTV-Python-Client/1.0'
        })
        
    def _request(self, method: str, endpoint: str, params: Optional[Dict] = None,
                 data: Optional[Dict] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Make an API request.
        
        Args:
            method: HTTP method (GET, POST, etc.)
            endpoint: API endpoint path
            params: Query parameters
            data: Request body data
            
        Returns:
            Response data as dictionary
            
        Raises:
            MythTVAPIError: If the request fails
        """
        url = urljoin(self.base_url, endpoint)
        
        try:
            response = self.session.request(
                method=method,
                url=url,
                params=params,
                json=data,
                timeout=self.timeout
            )
            response.raise_for_status()
            
            # MythTV API returns JSON
            return response.json()
            
        except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
            logger.error(f"API request failed: {e}")
            raise MythTVAPIError(f"Request failed: {str(e)}") from e
        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to decode response: {e}")
            raise MythTVAPIError(f"Invalid response format: {str(e)}") from e
            
    def get_host_info(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get MythTV host information"""
        return self._request('GET', '/Myth/GetHostName')
    
    def get_settings(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get MythTV settings"""
        return self._request('GET', '/Myth/GetSetting')
    
    # Channel Service Methods
    
    def get_channels(self, source_id: Optional[int] = None, 
                     start_index: int = 0, count: Optional[int] = None) -> List[Channel]:
        """
        Get list of channels.
        
        Args:
            source_id: Optional source ID to filter channels
            start_index: Starting index for pagination
            count: Number of channels to return
            
        Returns:
            List of Channel objects
        """
        params = {
            'StartIndex': start_index
        }
        if source_id:
            params['SourceID'] = source_id
        if count:
            params['Count'] = count
            
        response = self._request('GET', '/Channel/GetChannelInfoList', params=params)
        channels = response.get('ChannelInfoList', {}).get('ChannelInfos', [])
        
        return [Channel.from_dict(ch) for ch in channels]
    
    def get_channel(self, channel_id: int) -> Channel:
        """Get information for a specific channel"""
        params = {'ChanID': channel_id}
        response = self._request('GET', '/Channel/GetChannelInfo', params=params)
        return Channel.from_dict(response.get('ChannelInfo', {}))
    
    # DVR Service Methods
    
    def get_recordings(self, recording_group: str = 'Default',
                      start_index: int = 0, count: Optional[int] = None) -> List[Recording]:
        """
        Get list of recordings.
        
        Args:
            recording_group: Recording group name (default: 'Default')
            start_index: Starting index for pagination
            count: Number of recordings to return
            
        Returns:
            List of Recording objects
        """
        params = {
            'RecGroup': recording_group,
            'StartIndex': start_index
        }
        if count:
            params['Count'] = count
            
        response = self._request('GET', '/Dvr/GetRecordedList', params=params)
        recordings = response.get('ProgramList', {}).get('Programs', [])
        
        return [Recording.from_dict(rec) for rec in recordings]
    
    def get_recording(self, recording_id: int) -> Recording:
        """Get information for a specific recording"""
        params = {'RecordedId': recording_id}
        response = self._request('GET', '/Dvr/GetRecorded', params=params)
        return Recording.from_dict(response.get('Program', {}))
    
    def delete_recording(self, recording_id: int, force: bool = False) -> bool:
        """
        Delete a recording.
        
        Args:
            recording_id: ID of the recording to delete
            force: Force deletion even if file is in use
            
        Returns:
            True if successful
        """
        params = {
            'RecordedId': recording_id,
            'ForceDelete': str(force).lower()
        }
        response = self._request('POST', '/Dvr/RemoveRecorded', params=params)
        return response.get('bool', False)
    
    def get_upcoming_recordings(self, start_index: int = 0, 
                               count: Optional[int] = None) -> List[Program]:
        """Get list of upcoming recordings"""
        params = {'StartIndex': start_index}
        if count:
            params['Count'] = count
            
        response = self._request('GET', '/Dvr/GetUpcomingList', params=params)
        programs = response.get('ProgramList', {}).get('Programs', [])
        
        return [Program.from_dict(prog) for prog in programs]
    
    # Guide Service Methods
    
    def get_program_guide(self, start_time: Optional[datetime] = None,
                         end_time: Optional[datetime] = None,
                         channel_ids: Optional[List[int]] = None) -> List[Program]:
        """
        Get program guide data.
        
        Args:
            start_time: Start time for guide data
            end_time: End time for guide data
            channel_ids: List of channel IDs to include
            
        Returns:
            List of Program objects
        """
        params = {}
        
        if start_time:
            params['StartTime'] = start_time.isoformat()
        if end_time:
            params['EndTime'] = end_time.isoformat()
        if channel_ids:
            params['ChanId'] = ','.join(str(id) for id in channel_ids)
            
        response = self._request('GET', '/Guide/GetProgramGuide', params=params)
        
        programs = []
        channels = response.get('ProgramGuide', {}).get('Channels', [])
        
        for channel in channels:
            for program in channel.get('Programs', []):
                programs.append(Program.from_dict(program))
                
        return programs
    
    def get_program_details(self, channel_id: int, start_time: datetime) -> Program:
        """Get detailed information for a specific program"""
        params = {
            'ChanId': channel_id,
            'StartTime': start_time.isoformat()
        }
        response = self._request('GET', '/Guide/GetProgramDetails', params=params)
        return Program.from_dict(response.get('Program', {}))
    
    # Content Service Methods
    
    def search_programs(self, title: Optional[str] = None,
                       subtitle: Optional[str] = None,
                       description: Optional[str] = None,
                       category: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Program]:
        """
        Search for programs.
        
        Args:
            title: Program title to search for
            subtitle: Program subtitle to search for
            description: Search in descriptions
            category: Program category to filter by
            
        Returns:
            List of Program objects matching search criteria
        """
        params = {}
        
        if title:
            params['Title'] = title
        if subtitle:
            params['SubTitle'] = subtitle
        if description:
            params['Description'] = description
        if category:
            params['Category'] = category
            
        response = self._request('GET', '/Content/Search', params=params)
        programs = response.get('ProgramList', {}).get('Programs', [])
        
        return [Program.from_dict(prog) for prog in programs]
    
    def get_recording_url(self, recording_id: int) -> str:
        """
        Get streaming URL for a recording.
        
        Args:
            recording_id: ID of the recording
            
        Returns:
            URL for streaming the recording
        """
        return f"{self.base_url}/Content/GetRecording?RecordedId={recording_id}"
    
    def get_preview_image_url(self, recording_id: int, 
                             width: Optional[int] = None,
                             height: Optional[int] = None) -> str:
        """
        Get URL for a recording's preview image.
        
        Args:
            recording_id: ID of the recording
            width: Optional width of the preview image
            height: Optional height of the preview image
            
        Returns:
            URL for the preview image
        """
        params = {'RecordedId': recording_id}
        
        if width:
            params['Width'] = width
        if height:
            params['Height'] = height
            
        param_str = '&'.join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in params.items())
        return f"{self.base_url}/Content/GetPreviewImage?{param_str}"
    
    # Recording Rule Methods
    
    def schedule_recording(self, channel_id: int, start_time: datetime,
                          recording_type: str = 'Single Record') -> bool:
        """
        Schedule a recording.
        
        Args:
            channel_id: Channel ID
            start_time: Program start time
            recording_type: Type of recording rule
            
        Returns:
            True if successful
        """
        params = {
            'ChanId': channel_id,
            'StartTime': start_time.isoformat(),
            'Type': recording_type
        }
        response = self._request('POST', '/Dvr/AddRecordSchedule', params=params)
        return response.get('uint', 0) > 0
    
    def get_recording_rules(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Get all recording rules"""
        response = self._request('GET', '/Dvr/GetRecordScheduleList')
        return response.get('RecRuleList', {}).get('RecRules', [])
    
    def delete_recording_rule(self, rule_id: int) -> bool:
        """
        Delete a recording rule.
        
        Args:
            rule_id: ID of the recording rule
            
        Returns:
            True if successful
        """
        params = {'RecordId': rule_id}
        response = self._request('POST', '/Dvr/RemoveRecordSchedule', params=params)
        return response.get('bool', False)


# Example usage and tests
if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Example: Initialize client
    client = MythTVClient('localhost')
    
    try:
        # Get host info
        print("Host Info:")
        print(client.get_host_info())
        print()
        
        # Get channels
        print("Channels:")
        channels = client.get_channels(count=5)
        for channel in channels:
            print(f"  {channel.channel_number}: {channel.channel_name}")
        print()
        
        # Get recordings
        print("Recordings:")
        recordings = client.get_recordings(count=5)
        for rec in recordings:
            print(f"  {rec.title} - {rec.subtitle} ({rec.start_time})")
        print()
        
        # Search programs
        print("Search Results:")
        results = client.search_programs(title="News")
        for prog in results[:5]:
            print(f"  {prog.title} on channel {prog.channel_id}")
            
    except MythTVAPIError as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")

        """Get information for a specific recording"""
        params = {'RecordedId': recording_id}
        response = self._request('GET', '/Dvr/GetRecorded', params=params)
        return Recording.from_dict(response.get('Program', {}))
    
    def delete_recording(self, recording_id: int, force: bool = False) -> bool:
        """
        Delete a recording.
        
        Args:
            recording_id: ID of the recording to delete
            force: Force deletion even if file is in use
            
        Returns:
            True if successful
        """
        params = {
            'RecordedId': recording_id,
            'ForceDelete': str(force).lower()
        }
        response = self._request('POST', '/Dvr/RemoveRecorded', params=params)
        return response.get('bool', False)
    
    def get_upcoming_recordings(self, start_index: int = 0, 
                               count: Optional[int] = None) -> List[Program]:
        """Get list of upcoming recordings"""
        params = {'StartIndex': start_index}
        if count:
            params['Count'] = count
            
        response = self._request('GET', '/Dvr/GetUpcomingList', params=params)
        programs = response.get('ProgramList', {}).get('Programs', [])
        
        return [Program.from_dict(prog) for prog in programs]
    
    # Guide Service Methods
    
    def get_program_guide(self, start_time: Optional[datetime] = None,
                         end_time: Optional[datetime] = None,
                         channel_ids: Optional[List[int]] = None) -> List[Program]:
        """
        Get program guide data.
        
        Args:
            start_time: Start time for guide data
            end_time: End time for guide data
            channel_ids: List of channel IDs to include
            
        Returns:
            List of Program objects
        """
        params = {}
        
        if start_time:
            params['StartTime'] = start_time.isoformat()
        if end_time:
            params['EndTime'] = end_time.isoformat()
        if channel_ids:
            params['ChanId'] = ','.join(str(id) for id in channel_ids)
            
        response = self._request('GET', '/Guide/GetProgramGuide', params=params)
        
        programs = []
        channels = response.get('ProgramGuide', {}).get('Channels', [])
        
        for channel in channels:
            for program in channel.get('Programs', []):
                programs.append(Program.from_dict(program))
                
        return programs
    
    def get_program_details(self, channel_id: int, start_time: datetime) -> Program:
        """Get detailed information for a specific program"""
        params = {
            'ChanId': channel_id,
            'StartTime': start_time.isoformat()
        }
        response = self._request('GET', '/Guide/GetProgramDetails', params=params)
        return Program.from_dict(response.get('Program', {}))
    
    # Content Service Methods
    
    def search_programs(self, title: Optional[str] = None,
                       subtitle: Optional[str] = None,
                       description: Optional[str] = None,
                       category: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Program]:
        """
        Search for programs.
        
        Args:
            title: Program title to search for
            subtitle: Program subtitle to search for
            description: Search in descriptions
            category: Program category to filter by
            
        Returns:
            List of Program objects matching search criteria
        """
        params = {}
        
        if title:
            params['Title'] = title
        if subtitle:
            params['SubTitle'] = subtitle
        if description:
            params['Description'] = description
        if category:
            params['Category'] = category
            
        response = self._request('GET', '/Content/Search', params=params)
        programs = response.get('ProgramList', {}).get('Programs', [])
        
        return [Program.from_dict(prog) for prog in programs]
    
    def get_recording_url(self, recording_id: int) -> str:
        """
        Get streaming URL for a recording.
        
        Args:
            recording_id: ID of the recording
            
        Returns:
            URL for streaming the recording
        """
        return f"{self.base_url}/Content/GetRecording?RecordedId={recording_id}"
    
    def get_preview_image_url(self, recording_id: int, 
                             width: Optional[int] = None,
                             height: Optional[int] = None) -> str:
        """
        Get URL for a recording's preview image.
        
        Args:
            recording_id: ID of the recording
            width: Optional width of the preview image
            height: Optional height of the preview image
            
        Returns:
            URL for the preview image
        """
        params = {'RecordedId': recording_id}
        
        if width:
            params['Width'] = width
        if height:
            params['Height'] = height
            
        param_str = '&'.join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in params.items())
        return f"{self.base_url}/Content/GetPreviewImage?{param_str}"
    
    # Recording Rule Methods
    
    def schedule_recording(self, channel_id: int, start_time: datetime,
                          recording_type: str = 'Single Record') -> bool:
        """
        Schedule a recording.
        
        Args:
            channel_id: Channel ID
            start_time: Program start time
            recording_type: Type of recording rule
            
        Returns:
            True if successful
        """
        params = {
            'ChanId': channel_id,
            'StartTime': start_time.isoformat(),
            'Type': recording_type
        }
        response = self._request('POST', '/Dvr/AddRecordSchedule', params=params)
        return response.get('uint', 0) > 0
    
    def get_recording_rules(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Get all recording rules"""
        response = self._request('GET', '/Dvr/GetRecordScheduleList')
        return response.get('RecRuleList', {}).get('RecRules', [])
    
    def delete_recording_rule(self, rule_id: int) -> bool:
        """
        Delete a recording rule.
        
        Args:
            rule_id: ID of the recording rule
            
        Returns:
            True if successful
        """
        params = {'RecordId': rule_id}
        response = self._request('POST', '/Dvr/RemoveRecordSchedule', params=params)
        return response.get('bool', False)
